_about: Single source of truth for the Windows x86-64 third-party rebuilds used by the Source.Python spWinx64 port. Every GitHub Actions build job reads this file. Everything targets MSVC x86-64, static CRT (/MT), Release, matching how src/makefiles/win32/win32.base.cmake links the binaries. An empty expected_sha256 means 'record the digest on first download'; once a digest is recorded here the job fails if the upstream file changes.

boost.build: direct cl.exe/lib.exe (b2's MSVC toolset provisioning is bypassed); see scripts/build-boost.ps1
boost.python_for_headers: actions/setup-python@v5, python-version 3.13, architecture x64 (headers only; the import lib is vendored in Source.Python)

components.python313: all libs/python/src/**/*.cpp except libs/python/src/numpy/** (27 translation units)

asmjit.pin_note: Upstream asmjit publishes no git tags or GitHub releases. Pinned to the last master commit whose src/asmjit/core/api-config.h defines ASMJIT_ABI_NAMESPACE v1_14 (dated 2025-05-08, the parent of the v1.15 ABI bump 6c9a6b24). This matches the headers vendored in Source.Python (AsmJit/include/core/api-config.h: '#define ASMJIT_ABI_NAMESPACE v1_14'). Current master is v1_18 and is ABI-incompatible and must not be used.

dyncall.source_note: The canonical dyncall repository is a Mercurial hgweb instance at dyncall.org, not GitHub: hgweb archive downloads are disabled (HTTP 403/404) and there is no official GitHub mirror. The official release tarball with its published SHA256 is therefore used; it is verified to contain a top-level CMakeLists.txt and cross-checks against hg changeset 2f28f26c72a7 (tag r1.1).
dyncall.vendored_note: The libraries vendored in Source.Python were originally built from a 1.2-dev master snapshot. The Win64 dyncall/dyncallback/dynload backends are unchanged between release 1.1 and that snapshot, so the formal 1.1 release is pinned for a reproducible, checksummed source.
dyncall.build: cmake -A x64 -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 -DLANG_CXX=OFF -DCMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY=MultiThreaded (upstream cmake_minimum_required is 2.6, hence the policy override; tests/docs are EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

dynamichooks.source: Checked out from the sibling Source.Python repository (it carries the Windows x86-64 hook fixes; upstream DynamicHooks does not).
dynamichooks.build: direct cl.exe/lib.exe, defines DYNAMICHOOKS_X86_64 ASMJIT_STATIC WIN32 _WIN32 _WIN64 NDEBUG, C++ /std:c++17

python_runtime.kind: official CPython embeddable distribution (interpreter is NOT rebuilt from source to avoid ABI drift)
python_runtime.rationale: Source.Python ships its own standard library, so the embeddable stdlib zip and path config are not used. Only the native runtime DLLs and extension modules are packaged, which are exactly the 28 PE-x86-64 files verified on a working Counter-Strike: Source x64 server.
python_runtime.outputs_summary: python3.dll, python313.dll, vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll, libffi-8.dll, libcrypto-3.dll, libssl-3.dll, sqlite3.dll and the x86-64 .pyd extension modules
